name: motor_mount
description: Motor mount plate 100 x 70 x 16. Outer profile with R8 corners and a 1 mm x 45deg chamfer on the top outer edge. Central counterbore pocket D40 x 6 deep with a D22 through bore. Four D6.6 through holes with D11 x 6.5 deep counterbores. Rectangular pocket 30 x 20 x 8 deep (corner R3) with a D10 island standing 5 mm high. One through slot 8 wide x 25 long (obround).
